title: BUILDING A STRONGER AND MORE PROSPEROUS INDIA REQUIRES EFFECTIVE INSTITUTIONS AND PUBLIC SERVANTS: LOK SABHA SPEAKER
subtitle:
TECHNOLOGY MUST BE LEVERAGED TO PREVENT AND DETECT CRIME AND STRENGTHEN INTERNAL SECURITY: LOK SABHA SPEAKER
LOK SABHA SPEAKER INTERACTS WITH IPS PROBATIONERS IN PARLIAMENT HOUSE COMPLEX
body_text:
Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla today emphasised that building a stronger and more prosperous India requires effective institutions and public servants who are responsive to the aspirations and concerns of citizens. He underlined that police officers must maintain constant engagement with the public, communicate with people regularly, and develop a close understanding of their needs and challenges. He said that public trust is the cornerstone of effective policing. He called upon the probationers to earn the confidence of citizens through impartiality, transparency, accessibility and prompt action. He observed that the police must be perceived not merely as an agency responsible for maintaining law and order, but also as a dependable institution that stands with people and safeguards their rights and security. Shri Birla made these remarks while interacting with a group of IPS probationers at the Parliament House Complex. He called upon them to dedicate themselves wholeheartedly to the service of the people and the nation. Shri Birla observed that the Indian Police Service offers a unique opportunity to make a meaningful difference in people's lives. He urged the probationers to discharge their responsibilities with a deep sense of commitment, integrity, sensitivity and accountability, keeping public welfare at the centre of their professional conduct. Highlighting the transformative role of technology in policing, the Lok Sabha Speaker encouraged the young officers to make optimal use of emerging technologies, digital tools, data analytics and modern investigative techniques to prevent and detect crime. He noted that technology-driven policing can enhance operational efficiency, improve responsiveness and strengthen the overall law-and-order framework. Shri Birla further observed that the challenges facing society are constantly evolving and called upon the probationers to remain open to new ideas, continuously upgrade their professional capabilities, and adopt innovative approaches to policing. He stressed that effective policing must combine technological advancement with human sensitivity and compassion. The Speaker expressed confidence that the young officers, with their professional training, commitment and enthusiasm, would make valuable contributions towards strengthening the country's internal security and building a safe, secure and progressive India. The interaction provided an opportunity for the IPS probationers to exchange views with the Lok Sabha Speaker and gain insights into the functioning of Parliament and India's democratic institutions. संविधान सदन के केंद्रीय कक्ष में संसद के अध्ययन दौरे पर आए भारतीय पुलिस सेवा (IPS) के 78वें आरआर बैच (2025 बैच) के अधिकारियों के साथ संवाद किया।

भारत की संसद और संसदीय प्रणाली हमारे लोकतंत्र की गौरवशाली पहचान हैं। संविधान विधायिका, कार्यपालिका और न्यायपालिका के दायित्वों को निर्धारित करते हुए न्याय, समानता और बंधुता पर आधारित शासन व्यवस्था का मार्गदर्शन करता है। कानून और नीतियों की वास्तविक सार्थकता उनके प्रभावी क्रियान्वयन में निहित होती है, जिसकी महत्वपूर्ण जिम्मेदारी प्रशासनिक एवं पुलिस अधिकारियों पर होती है। युवा अधिकारियों से अपेक्षा है कि वे संवेदनशीलता, निष्पक्षता और जनसेवा की भावना के साथ अपने दायित्वों का निर्वहन करें। कानून का उद्देश्य केवल व्यवस्था बनाए रखना नहीं, बल्कि प्रत्येक नागरिक के अधिकारों और गरिमा की रक्षा करना भी है। समाज के अंतिम व्यक्ति तक न्याय और सुरक्षा का विश्वास पहुँचाना ही लोकसेवा की वास्तविक कसौटी है। पुलिस सेवा में महिलाओं की बढ़ती भागीदारी भी एक सकारात्मक परिवर्तन है। 
मुझे विश्वास है कि ये युवा अधिकारी अपनी निष्ठा, दक्षता और मानवीय दृष्टिकोण से राष्ट्रसेवा करते हुए सुशासन और लोकतांत्रिक मूल्यों को और सुदृढ़ करेंगे।
